Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square story identity icon, to display at 64 CSS pixels and later on a phone home screen. Generate ONE original icon, square canvas, ideally 256x256 pixels (a larger square source is acceptable). Genuine transparent alpha background. A strong compact silhouette fills about 90% of the square, with slight breathing room to avoid clipping. No scenic backdrop, no solid-color tile, no circle or badge frame, no border, no drop shadow, no lettering, no watermark. The subject itself may be opaque and richly colored. Prioritize recognition at 64px; simplify fine details.
Subject and art direction: A warm ochre earthenware mixing bowl containing folded pale bread dough, with a plain wooden spoon resting diagonally inside it. The dough and spoon are clearly distinct. Cook's Pen art direction: observed food structure, fine irregular dark pen contours, restrained warm watercolor washes, early twentieth-century cookbook illustration. A single useful cooking object group, warm and inviting.

Humble useful shelter in a world of crafts, orchards and a river community. Rustic colored woodcut with slightly irregular carved contours, ochre, muted green and warm brick-red accents. Strong simple shape, no landscape or ground slab.

Edit the supplied Settlement icon. Preserve the cottage, rustic colored-woodcut style, warm ochre/brick-red/moss-green palette, square composition and genuine transparent alpha background. Replace the uncanny branch that appears to emerge from the house with a complete SMALL APPLE TREE unmistakably standing FULLY IN FRONT OF the cottage on the right. Show one continuous visible trunk all the way down to its own roots below the house's front-wall baseline; tree trunk and canopy visibly occlude part of the front wall. The tree grows from its own ground contact, never from roof or wall. A compact rounded leafy crown, two red apples, strong woodcut outlines. Keep the doorway and most roof visible. No scenic backdrop, no baseplate, no border, no text. Fill the square tightly without clipping.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square transparent PNG icon for an adult philosophical story titled Creation, to read at 64 CSS pixels and also be usable as a home-screen icon.
Primary request: an original profound, numinous image of Genesis, the world coming into being: light separating from darkness, waters separating from fertile earth, and living forms emerging. The planet must be felt as a whole world, with the creation of life as important as cosmic light.
Input images: the first two supplied pictures (multicoloured rays from a white centre; circular land-and-sea mosaic) are inspiration only, not edit targets. The third picture, a screenshot of a book/armillary icon and heading, is unrelated: ignore it.
Visual concept: a single almost circular, unframed field of hand-cut stained glass and stone mosaic, filling the square nearly edge to edge with actual transparency outside the silhouette. Within it, a searing small ivory-gold source of light opens out through profound indigo darkness. Broad sweeping ultramarine and turquoise currents become the sea, an interlocking rising sweep of earthy gold and deep green becomes land. An expressive branching form and a few leaflike shapes emerge organically within the land, not a literal tree perched on a globe. One or two archaic animal/bird-like marks can be discovered within these shapes; they remain integral to the composition, never cute miniature characters. Let luminous fractured gold connect light, land and life.
Mood: awe, mystery, birth, gravity and abundance; the bold visual authority of sacred art. Deep mineral colours, uneven handmade tesserae and rich painterly marks. Inspired conceptually by the emergence of forms in creation art and the luminosity of stained glass; create an original composition, not a reproduction of any reference artwork.
Composition: simple large interlocking forms and strongly differentiated light/dark masses that remain readable at 64px. A coherent earth-like round silhouette, but no geographical map, no shiny globe, no toy planet or diorama. Edge-to-edge artwork inside the silhouette, with only a thin transparent margin. No separate backdrop, pedestal, frame, text or watermark.
Avoid: twee storybook scenery, pastoral paradise, little deer, flowers, cartoon animals, a sprout sticking out of a planet, photorealistic space imagery, cutesy rainbow palette, jewel jewellery renders, decorative mandala symmetry, elaborate tiny details.
references: User-supplied painting of coloured rays converging at white light (conversation attachment, not retained locally).
User-supplied circular land-and-sea mosaic (conversation attachment, not retained locally).
User's catalogue alignment screenshot (included by conversation image selection, explicitly ignored in the prompt).
